scope: Three published raster simulations; actual isolated Stage stories at desktop DPR1 and mobile DPR2, prepared fonts, all three scheduled model inputs and complete Type idle-wave timing. Public route/module-transfer startup and final site-wide performance remain unverified.
findings: All twelve normal-speed runs average 60fps with zero slow intervals and first paint below 133ms.
4x CPU results retain native Fluid desktop frame gaps, several first paints above 300ms, and full-view gaps, especially Fire on mobile. These are open performance audit findings.
Each twelve-second story asserts its complete elapsed-time input schedule and resulting model states. Source hashes and CDP trace hashes bind all measurements.

measurements.scope: Twelve-second input stories including complete Type idle-wave timing, original fuel duration and solver reset. Actual isolated native and complete full Stage CPU-throttled stories at desktop DPR1 and mobile DPR2. Fonts are prepared before mounting. First contentful paint and observed readiness are recorded; CDP traces bind paint/layout work and frame gaps. These measurements do not declare final timing gates passed or include public route/module transfer.
